_README: My 3-window Spotify taste export, consumed by scripts/refresh-data.mjs. Windows map to Spotify's top-artists ranges: short_term ≈ 1 month, medium_term ≈ 6 months, long_term ≈ lifetime. 'artists' = top artist names for that window (case-insensitive); 'genres' = associated genre labels. This is a STUB with example values — replace with the real export before refreshing. No API keys are involved; this file is produced separately from your own Spotify data.
